question: Should Atractylis gummifera be recommended for: traditional remedy (root decoction/poultice use)?

records.notes: A retrospective review of 467 cases of Atractylis gummifera poisoning reported to a national poison control centre over nearly 30 years found an overall mortality rate of 39.2%, with children making up the majority of cases and the large majority of deaths occurring in children under 15 following accidental exposure; the plant's atractyloside compounds cause severe hepatic and renal failure.
records.source_type: Poison control centre retrospective case series
records.source_title: Prognostic factors of Atractylis gummifera L. poisoning, Morocco
